sourceTitle: Gallery of Comicalities; Embracing Humorous Sketches
description: "Gallery of Comicalities; Embracing Humorous Sketches" by Robert Cruikshank et al. is a collection of humorous sketches written in the early 19th century. The anthology features the works of notable caricaturists, including the renowned brothers Robert and George Cruikshank, and offers a satirical glimpse into the social customs and eccentricities of the time.
